SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

2. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   B. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   D. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.

4. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   B. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.

5. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   C. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   D. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

7. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   C. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   C. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.
   B. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.

11. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   C. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

13. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

14. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   B. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   D. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   D. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain The Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Improvement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Esteem Assessment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
